District Bound.name: District Bound
District Bound.description: The user's animal body runs at its full limit for the rest of the scene: each bound clears a city block, and they cross a district by rooftop, wall and street in moments, carrying up to two people at once. In one action they strike every enemy on a whole city block in turn with their natural weapons, dealing heavy slashing or bludgeoning damage; held back, each enemy is only knocked flat. When the scene ends the user's legs give out, and they cannot bound or sprint until they rest a full night. Strain: severe.
